data.adjudication: Concern raised; DOE said Wright was compliant and had no Oklo stock.
data.claim: A senator raised concern that Energy Secretary Chris Wright was acting in the interest of former board company Oklo as federal nuclear-fuel policy could benefit it. DOE said Wright complied with ethics requirements and had never owned Oklo stock.
clear_connection_paths: Chris Wright → former Oklo board seat → DOE nuclear-fuel decisions potentially benefiting Oklo
